content.short: Yooldo is a multi-chain Web3 gaming hub bridging esports and GameFi with a user-friendly interface.
content.description: Yooldo is an innovative Web3 gaming platform that serves as a multi-chain hub for esports and GameFi, currently supporting Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Linea. It focuses on bridging the gap between Web2 and Web3 by providing a seamless experience for both players and developers. The ecosystem features high-quality titles like Trouble Punk and Random Pirate Defense, where users can engage in competitive play-to-earn mechanics. Powered by the ESPORTS governance token and the $TROB in-game reward token, Yooldo aims to build a sustainable and transparent gaming economy that empowers its community.
content.meta: Yooldo provides a multi-chain gaming ecosystem for esports and competitive GameFi. Discover Yooldo and other Gaming Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
